title.zh: 风险池化与保险 · 一万人各摊一点
title.en: Risk Pooling & Insurance · Ten Thousand People Each Chip In

desc.zh: 个人遇到的是 0 或 10000 元的赌局；一万人合在一起，却变成一笔几乎可以预先算好的账——大数定律的商业形态，以及它失灵的地方。
desc.en: One person faces a gamble of $0 or $10,000; ten thousand together face an account that can be worked out ahead of time — the law of large numbers as a business, and where it fails.
